title_en: Humble’s Cozy After Dark Showcase Bundle Features 10 Spooky Indie Games That Are Perfect for Halloween That You Can Get for Just $12
summary_en: Humble Bundle's Cozy After Dark Showcase bundle features 10 wonderfully spooky indie games you can grab for as low as $12, including Fear the Spotlight, Paradise Killer, and more.
body_en:
Nothing beats jumping into a scary game around Halloween. But if you're someone who prefers games on the lighter side of spooky, Humble's Cozy After Dark Showcase Bundle is perfect for you. This collection of 10 eerie indies is available to grab for as low as $12, and features a great lineup that includes Paradise Killer and Fear the Spotlight .
If you were to buy all 10 of these games on their own, it'd set you back $176, so this is a fantastic offer to take advantage of. As of the time of writing, it's only available for another 18 days as well, so the countdown is on to grab it. Below, you can check out the full game lineup for this bundle, which can all be redeemed on Steam if you decide to treat yourself to it.
If really scary games aren't for you, this bundle is full of some great options that can bring you that spooky season atmosphere in a lighter fashion. Fear the Spotlight is one that I really enjoyed, which is a delightful love letter to PS1-era horror games and Blumhouse Games' debut launch.
There's also Paradise Killer, which is one writer Joe Skrebels gave a 9/10 to in his review , writing that it "marries a beautifully repulsive world with a gratifyingly open-ended approach to detective work, but its real achievement is in how it ties everything you’ve learned together."
If you don't want to pay the full $12 for all these games, though, there's some slight changes to the bundle. Dropping down to $8, the lowest amount, will net you five games instead of the full 10: Paradise Killer, Escape From Mystwood Mansion, a pet shop after dark, The Darkside Detective, and Kathy Rain Directors Cut.
And if you'd like to pay a bit extra instead, you'll be giving more money to publishers, Humble, and charity alongside getting the full set of 10 games. The charity for this bundle is Dames4Games as well, which supports women and femme-identifying people across gaming and tech.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the commerce team here at IGN.
